text.tspan: Dev, staging, prod: same modules, separate state, separate accounts
Option A (recommended): a directory per environment calling shared modules → different code version per env is possible,
a broken dev plan can never touch prod, each env has its own backend + IAM role.
Option B: workspaces (terraform workspace new prod) → one code path, state per workspace (env:/prod/… in S3);
easy to apply to the wrong workspace, same backend credentials for all. Fine for short-lived copies (feature envs).
Option C: Terragrunt to keep backend / provider blocks DRY across many envs and accounts.
